---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature for Station
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you're requesting.

## Problem / Use Case

Describe the problem you're trying to solve or the use case for this feature.

**Example:**
> I'm trying to [...] but currently Station doesn't support [...].

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you'd like this feature to work.

**Example API (if applicable):**

```php
// How you imagine using this feature
Station::newFeature()->doSomething();
```

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional Context

- Links to related issues or discussions
- Screenshots or diagrams (if helpful)
- Reference implementations in other projects

## Implementation

Would you be willing to submit a PR for this feature?

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to implement this
- [ ] I can help with testing/review
- [ ] No, I'm just suggesting

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this isn't a duplicate
- [ ] This feature aligns with Station's goals (queue management, job recovery)
- [ ] I have considered backward compatibility
